# Find the ranks of Denis Menchov and Stéphane Goubert
menchov_rank = df.loc[df['Cyclist'].str.contains('Denis Menchov'), 'Rank'].values[0]
goubert_rank = df.loc[df['Cyclist'].str.contains('Stéphane Goubert'), 'Rank'].values[0]

# Determine the lower and higher rank
lower_rank = min(menchov_rank, goubert_rank)
higher_rank = max(menchov_rank, goubert_rank)

# Get cyclists with ranks strictly between the two
between_cyclists = df[(df['Rank'] > lower_rank) & (df['Rank'] < higher_rank)]['Cyclist'].tolist()

answer = between_cyclists
